headlines.title: Inflation jumps to 3.7% as gas and diesel prices squeeze consumers ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: Prices rose across broad swaths of the economy in September, as high energy costs triggered by the Iran war pushed up costs in many major consumer categories.

headlines.title: Netflix to cut about 6% of worldwide staff
headlines.description: Netflix is eliminating about 1,000 jobs in a round of layoffs, according to a source with knowledge of the matter.

headlines.title: Ukraine accuses SpaceX of restricting Starlink, disrupting military as it reels from intel gaps
headlines.description: Ukraine has accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of disrupting its military operations by limiting Starlink internet services, as the country reeled from a pair of intense Russian missile attacks that it said came without the usual advance warning from allies.

headlines.title: Anthropic says its AI model submitted a false cold case tip to Philadelphia police
headlines.description: The bad tip “had minimal impact,” but Anthropic said it takes the action seriously, as “the same behaviors could do far more harm as models become more powerful.”

headlines.title: Britain faces ‘new era’ of security threats from Iran and Russia, MI5 says
headlines.description: Britain’s MI5 boss Ken McCallum warned of a range of threats posed by Russia, Iran, China, AI and terrorist groups.

headlines.title: OpenAI employee accused of bugging an executive conference room
headlines.description: OpenAI said the FBI has arrested Abdulrahman Alfozan, one of its employees, after being accused of bugging an executive conference room at the company's San Francisco office. Alfozan is a Saudi national and began working with OpenAI in 2025. NBC News' Liz Kreutz has more on the arrest and charges.

headlines.title: Massive cyberattack targets refrigerators in supermarkets across France
headlines.description: Mountains of fresh and frozen food had to be thrown out after hackers cranked the temperature of refrigerators in supermarkets across France. Experts say it could signal a new cybersecurity threat that could impact Americans as well. NBC’s Tom Costello reports.

headlines.title: 'I am not an AI-friendly actor': Nicolas Cage says he refused to sign Amazon AI waiver
headlines.description: Oscar-winning actor Nicolas Cage spoke out against artificial intelligence and Amazon, the studio behind his show "Spider-Noir," saying he refused to sign an AI waiver. It comes as the debate over artificial intelligence divides Hollywood. NBC News' Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Apple unveils new HomeView smart home hub
headlines.description: Apple has announced a new device called HomeView, a smart home hub designed to connect and control household devices, as well as make FaceTime calls and listen to music. NBC News’ Brian Cheung explains the features and Apple’s broader smart home strategy.

headlines.title: Hollywood puts the spotlight on Silicon Valley’s tech titans
headlines.description: Hollywood is putting the spotlight on Silicon Valley’s tech titans on the silver screen. NBC's Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Sharper vocals, cleaner sound — machine learning is cutting out ’noise’ at the Hollywood Bowl
headlines.description: Proprietary technology now in use by a growing number of major acts, recently took the stage at the famous Hollywood Bowl as part of the venue’s major sound upgrade. As NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports, audiences love it.

headlines.title: Would you go on a date just for free food? Gen Zers are dialing into the 'foodie call'
headlines.description: Gen Z singles are going on dates for one reason: free food. With dating costs topping $200 per outing, experts say economic anxiety is reshaping romance. NBC News' Joe Fryer reports.
